description: This file contains GUI dialog classes and utility functions for the BORIS behavioral observation software, including message dialogs, error handling, time selection widgets, overlay configuration, and data visualization components.

classes.name: Info_widget
classes.description: A widget displaying information with a label and list widget.

classes.name: get_time_widget
classes.description: A widget for selecting a time in seconds, hh:mm:ss, or date-time formats.

classes.name: Ask_time
classes.description: A dialog for prompting user to select a time in various formats.

classes.name: Video_overlay_dialog
classes.description: A dialog to configure video overlay image, position, and transparency.

classes.name: Input_dialog
classes.description: A flexible dialog for user input with various element types (checkbox, line edit, spinbox, combo box).

classes.name: Duplicate_items
classes.description: A dialog to display and select between behaviors or subjects coded by the same key.

classes.name: ChooseObservationsToImport
classes.description: A dialog for selecting multiple observations to import.

classes.name: FindInEvents
classes.description: A widget for searching within events with options for subject, behavior, modifiers, comment, and case sensitivity.

classes.name: FindReplaceEvents
classes.description: A widget for find and replace operations within events.

classes.name: Results_dialog
classes.description: A dialog for displaying text results with options to save.

classes.name: Results_dialog_exit_code
classes.description: A results dialog with multiple exit code buttons.

classes.name: View_data
classes.description: A dialog for visualizing data rows and statistics.

classes.name: View_explore_project_results
classes.description: A widget for visualizing results of project exploration with double-click interaction.

methods.name: MessageDialog
methods.description: Displays a message dialog with specified title, text, and buttons, returning the clicked button text.

methods.name: global_error_message
methods.description: Handles global errors by logging, saving to file, copying to clipboard, and showing an error dialog.
